spans.s:
मेल mf. (-लः-ला) Meeting, union, assemblage; in the modern dialects,
applied to a large concourse of people collected at stated periods
for religious or commercial purposes, as at Haridwār, &c.
 f. (-ला)
1.

. Antimony or any collyrium.
 3. Union, intercourse.
 4. A
company, a society.
 5. The indigo-plant.
 6. A musical scale. E.
मिल to mix, to meet, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. मेलन ।

मेलक m. (-कः) Meeting, union, assemblage.
 E. मेल the same, कन् added.

. Associating with.
4. Mixing with 5. Adding to.
 E. मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.

मेलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Mixing, adding, or causing to be mixed
with, or added to.
 E. मिल् to mix, causal v., शतृ aff.

मेलानन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दा) An inkstand.
 E. मेला ink, आनन्द delighting.

मेलान्धु f. (-न्धुः) An inkstand.
 E. मेला ink, अन्धु a well.

मेलाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) An inkstand.
 E. मेला ink, अम्बु water.
